"""Camera and proprioception controller for the live SweetenCoffee episode.

This script uses only RCB observations, camera calibration, and robot proprioception.
The wrist pose controller estimates a local arm Jacobian by small reversible joint
moves, then follows Cartesian waypoints while preserving the observed top-down grip
orientation. It does not read simulator state or use a policy/demo.
"""
import time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

EYE = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
LEFT = "robot0_agentview_left"
RIGHT = "robot0_agentview_right"
CENTER = "robot0_agentview_center"
CAMERAS = [CENTER, LEFT, RIGHT, EYE]

# Wrist camera orientation at the initial, safe top-down pose for this frozen scene.
R_GRASP = np.array([
    [0.10287783, 0.96785861, -0.22949038],
    [-0.99389223, 0.09076018, -0.06277587],
    [-0.03992957, 0.23454694, 0.97128439],
], dtype=float)


def rotvec(R):
    c = float(np.clip((np.trace(R) - 1.0) * 0.5, -1.0, 1.0))
    th = float(np.arccos(c))
    v = np.array([R[2, 1] - R[1, 2], R[0, 2] - R[2, 0], R[1, 0] - R[0, 1]])
    if th < 1e-7:
        return 0.5 * v
    s = float(np.sin(th))
    if abs(s) < 1e-7:
        # Not expected for the small local pose errors in this episode.
        axis = np.sqrt(np.maximum((np.diag(R) + 1.0) * 0.5, 0.0))
        axis[1] = np.copysign(axis[1], R[0, 1] + R[1, 0])
        axis[2] = np.copysign(axis[2], R[0, 2] + R[2, 0])
        return th * axis / max(np.linalg.norm(axis), 1e-9)
    return (th / (2.0 * s)) * v


def current(r, cameras=None, depth=False):
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or [EYE], include_depth=depth, video="none")
    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return o, now[4:11].copy(), now[26:29].copy(), np.asarray(o.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]


def action_rows(q, grip, n):
    a = np.zeros((n, 13), dtype=np.float64)
    a[:, :7] = q
    a[:, 7] = grip
    a[:, 12] = -1.0
    return a


def send_arm(r, qgoal, grip=-1.0, seconds=2.0, cameras=None, note="arm waypoint"):
    o, q0, _, _ = current(r, [EYE])
    nmove = max(30, int(np.ceil(seconds / 0.05)))
    nhold = 10
    n = nmove + nhold
    a = np.zeros((n, 13), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, t in enumerate(np.linspace(1.0 / nmove, 1.0, nmove)):
        a[i, :7] = q0 * (1.0 - t) + np.asarray(qgoal) * t
    a[nmove:, :7] = qgoal
    a[:, 7] = grip
    a[:, 12] = -1.0
    res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=cameras or [EYE], video="none", interpolate="hold", note=note)
    now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    print(note, "eef", np.round(now[26:29], 4), "q", np.round(now[4:11], 3), "time_left", round(res.meta.get("time_left_s", -1), 1))
    return res


def estimate_jacobian(r, grip=-1.0, h=0.025):
    """Forward-difference 6D wrist Jacobian from reversible single-joint probes."""
    _, q, p, R = current(r, [EYE])
    Jp = np.zeros((3, 7)); Jr = np.zeros((3, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        a = action_rows(q, grip, 20)
        a[:, j] += h
        res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[EYE], video="none", video_fps=1,
                       interpolate="hold", note=f"reversible wrist Jacobian probe j{j + 1}")
        now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
        q1, p1 = now[4:11], now[26:29]
        R1 = np.asarray(res.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
        dq = float(q1[j] - q[j])
        if abs(dq) < h * 0.45:
            # A longer probe only if the native controller did not track the small step.
            a = action_rows(q, grip, 20); a[:, j] += h * 2.0
            res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[EYE], video="none", video_fps=1,
                           interpolate="hold", note=f"extended Jacobian probe j{j + 1}")
            now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
            q1, p1 = now[4:11], now[26:29]
            R1 = np.asarray(res.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
            dq = float(q1[j] - q[j])
        if abs(dq) > 1e-5:
            Jp[:, j] = (p1 - p) / dq
            Jr[:, j] = rotvec(R1 @ R.T) / dq
        # Return to the local baseline before measuring the next column.
        a = action_rows(q, grip, 20)
        r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[], video="none", interpolate="hold",
                 note=f"restore after Jacobian probe j{j + 1}")
        _, q, p, R = current(r, [EYE])
    return np.vstack((Jp, Jr)), q, p, R


def pose_servo(r, target_p, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=-1.0, max_iter=18, label="pose servo"):
    target_p = np.asarray(target_p, dtype=float)
    for it in range(max_iter):
        _, q, p, R = current(r, [EYE])
        ep = target_p - p
        er = rotvec(target_R @ R.T)
        print(label, "iter", it, "position error", np.round(ep, 3), "rotation error", np.round(er, 3))
        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.012 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.035:
            return p, R
        J, q, p, R = estimate_jacobian(r, grip=grip)
        ep = target_p - p
        er = rotvec(target_R @ R.T)
        W = np.diag([1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.20, 0.20, 0.20])
        A = W @ J; b = W @ np.r_[ep, er]
        lam = 0.015
        dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + lam * lam * np.eye(6), b)
        mx = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
        if mx > 0.10:
            dq *= 0.10 / mx
        qgoal = q + dq
        lo = np.array([-2.8973, -1.7628, -2.8973, -3.0718, -2.8973, -0.0175, -2.8973]) + 0.03
        hi = np.array([ 2.8973,  1.7628,  2.8973, -0.0698,  2.8973,  3.7525,  2.8973]) - 0.03
        qgoal = np.clip(qgoal, lo, hi)
        send_arm(r, qgoal, grip=grip, seconds=1.8, cameras=[EYE], note=f"{label} step {it + 1}")
    raise RuntimeError(f"{label} did not converge")


def world_point(obs, camera, u, v):
    K = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    d = float(np.asarray(obs.depth[camera])[0, int(round(v)), int(round(u))])
    x = (u - K[0, 2]) * d / K[0, 0]
    y = -(v - K[1, 2]) * d / K[1, 1]
    return (T @ np.array([x, y, -d, 1.0]))[:3]


def perceive_sugar_and_coffee(obs):
    """Find the red sugar cube on the saucer and tan coffee surface in image ROIs."""
    # Saucer ROI excludes nearby cabinet and robot pixels. Keep top-facing cube pixels.
    im = obs.last[LEFT]
    roi = im[164:170, 130:145].astype(float)
    mask = (roi[:, :, 0] > roi[:, :, 1] * 1.35) & (roi[:, :, 0] > roi[:, :, 2] * 1.2) & (roi[:, :, 0] > 65)
    yy, xx = np.where(mask)
    if len(xx) < 4:
        raise RuntimeError("could not see sugar cube in the saucer ROI")

"""Camera and proprioception controller for the live SweetenCoffee episode.

This script uses only RCB observations, camera calibration, and robot proprioception.
The wrist pose controller estimates a local arm Jacobian by small reversible joint
moves, then follows Cartesian waypoints while preserving the observed top-down grip
orientation. It does not read simulator state or use a policy/demo.
"""
import time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

EYE = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
LEFT = "robot0_agentview_left"
RIGHT = "robot0_agentview_right"
CENTER = "robot0_agentview_center"
CAMERAS = [CENTER, LEFT, RIGHT, EYE]

# Wrist camera orientation at the initial, safe top-down pose for this frozen scene.
R_GRASP = np.array([
    [0.10287783, 0.96785861, -0.22949038],
    [-0.99389223, 0.09076018, -0.06277587],
    [-0.03992957, 0.23454694, 0.97128439],
], dtype=float)


def rotvec(R):
    c = float(np.clip((np.trace(R) - 1.0) * 0.5, -1.0, 1.0))
    th = float(np.arccos(c))
    v = np.array([R[2, 1] - R[1, 2], R[0, 2] - R[2, 0], R[1, 0] - R[0, 1]])
    if th < 1e-7:
        return 0.5 * v
    s = float(np.sin(th))
    if abs(s) < 1e-7:
        # Not expected for the small local pose errors in this episode.
        axis = np.sqrt(np.maximum((np.diag(R) + 1.0) * 0.5, 0.0))
        axis[1] = np.copysign(axis[1], R[0, 1] + R[1, 0])
        axis[2] = np.copysign(axis[2], R[0, 2] + R[2, 0])
        return th * axis / max(np.linalg.norm(axis), 1e-9)
    return (th / (2.0 * s)) * v


def current(r, cameras=None, depth=False):
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or [EYE], include_depth=depth, video="none")
    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return o, now[4:11].copy(), now[26:29].copy(), np.asarray(o.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]


def action_rows(q, grip, n):
    a = np.zeros((n, 13), dtype=np.float64)
    a[:, :7] = q
    a[:, 7] = grip
    a[:, 12] = -1.0
    return a


def send_arm(r, qgoal, grip=-1.0, seconds=2.0, cameras=None, note="arm waypoint"):
    o, q0, _, _ = current(r, [EYE])
    nmove = max(30, int(np.ceil(seconds / 0.05)))
    nhold = 10
    n = nmove + nhold
    a = np.zeros((n, 13), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, t in enumerate(np.linspace(1.0 / nmove, 1.0, nmove)):
        a[i, :7] = q0 * (1.0 - t) + np.asarray(qgoal) * t
    a[nmove:, :7] = qgoal
    a[:, 7] = grip
    a[:, 12] = -1.0
    res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=cameras or [EYE], video="none", interpolate="hold", note=note)
    now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    print(note, "eef", np.round(now[26:29], 4), "q", np.round(now[4:11], 3), "time_left", round(res.meta.get("time_left_s", -1), 1))
    return res


def estimate_jacobian(r, grip=-1.0, h=0.025):
    """Forward-difference 6D wrist Jacobian from reversible single-joint probes."""
    _, q, p, R = current(r, [EYE])
    Jp = np.zeros((3, 7)); Jr = np.zeros((3, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        a = action_rows(q, grip, 20)
        a[:, j] += h
        res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[EYE], video="none", video_fps=1,
                       interpolate="hold", note=f"reversible wrist Jacobian probe j{j + 1}")
        now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
        q1, p1 = now[4:11], now[26:29]
        R1 = np.asarray(res.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
        dq = float(q1[j] - q[j])
        if abs(dq) < h * 0.45:
            # A longer probe only if the native controller did not track the small step.
            a = action_rows(q, grip, 20); a[:, j] += h * 2.0
            res = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[EYE], video="none", video_fps=1,
                           interpolate="hold", note=f"extended Jacobian probe j{j + 1}")
            now = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
            q1, p1 = now[4:11], now[26:29]
            R1 = np.asarray(res.meta["cameras"][EYE]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
            dq = float(q1[j] - q[j])
        if abs(dq) > 1e-5:
            Jp[:, j] = (p1 - p) / dq
            Jr[:, j] = rotvec(R1 @ R.T) / dq
        # Return to the local baseline before measuring the next column.
        a = action_rows(q, grip, 20)
        r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[], video="none", interpolate="hold",
                 note=f"restore after Jacobian probe j{j + 1}")
        _, q, p, R = current(r, [EYE])
    return np.vstack((Jp, Jr)), q, p, R


def pose_servo(r, target_p, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=-1.0, max_iter=18, label="pose servo"):
    target_p = np.asarray(target_p, dtype=float)
    for it in range(max_iter):
        _, q, p, R = current(r, [EYE])
        ep = target_p - p
        er = rotvec(target_R @ R.T)
        print(label, "iter", it, "position error", np.round(ep, 3), "rotation error", np.round(er, 3))
        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.007 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.025:
            return p, R
        J, q, p, R = estimate_jacobian(r, grip=grip)
        ep = target_p - p
        er = rotvec(target_R @ R.T)
        W = np.diag([1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.20, 0.20, 0.20])
        A = W @ J; b = W @ np.r_[ep, er]
        lam = 0.015
        dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + lam * lam * np.eye(6), b)
        mx = float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))
        if mx > 0.14:
            dq *= 0.14 / mx
        qgoal = q + dq
        lo = np.array([-2.8973, -1.7628, -2.8973, -3.0718, -2.8973, -0.0175, -2.8973]) + 0.03
        hi = np.array([ 2.8973,  1.7628,  2.8973, -0.0698,  2.8973,  3.7525,  2.8973]) - 0.03
        qgoal = np.clip(qgoal, lo, hi)
        send_arm(r, qgoal, grip=grip, seconds=1.8, cameras=[EYE], note=f"{label} step {it + 1}")
    raise RuntimeError(f"{label} did not converge")


def world_point(obs, camera, u, v):
    K = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    d = float(np.asarray(obs.depth[camera])[0, int(round(v)), int(round(u))])
    x = (u - K[0, 2]) * d / K[0, 0]
    y = -(v - K[1, 2]) * d / K[1, 1]
    return (T @ np.array([x, y, -d, 1.0]))[:3]


def perceive_sugar_and_coffee(obs):
    """Find the red sugar cube on the saucer and tan coffee surface in image ROIs."""
    def components(mask):
        h, w = mask.shape
        seen = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)
        out = []
        for y0 in range(h):
            for x0 in range(w):
                if not mask[y0, x0] or seen[y0, x0]:
                    continue
                todo = [(y0, x0)]; seen[y0, x0] = True; pts = []
                while todo:
                    y, x = todo.pop(); pts.append((y, x))
                    for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                        for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                            yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                            if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and mask[yy, xx] and not seen[yy, xx]:
                                seen[yy, xx] = True; todo.append((yy, xx))
                if len(pts) >= 5:
                    out.append(np.asarray(pts))
        return out

    # A small red connected component on the white saucer is the sugar cube.
    im = obs.last[LEFT].astype(float)
    x0, y0 = 100, 150
    roi = im[y0:202, x0:148]
    red = (roi[:, :, 0] > roi[:, :, 1] * 1.35) & (roi[:, :, 0] > roi[:, :, 2] * 1.2) & (roi[:, :, 0] > 65)
    sugar_comps = [c for c in components(red) if 8 <= len(c) <= 120]
    if not sugar_comps:
        raise RuntimeError("could not see sugar cube in the saucer ROI")
    pts = max(sugar_comps, key=len)
    u, v = x0 + float(np.median(pts[:, 1])), y0 + float(np.median(pts[:, 0]))
    sugar_top = world_point(obs, LEFT, u, v)

    # The tan connected component inside the red mug is the coffee surface.
    im = obs.last[RIGHT].astype(float)
    x0, y0 = 105, 140
    roi = im[y0:182, x0:180]
    tan = (roi[:, :, 0] > 115) & (roi[:, :, 1] > 55) & (roi[:, :, 0] > roi[:, :, 1] * 1.20) & (roi[:, :, 2] < 90)
    coffee_comps = [c for c in components(tan) if len(c) >= 15]
    if not coffee_comps:
        raise RuntimeError("could not see coffee surface in the mug ROI")
    pts = max(coffee_comps, key=len)
    u, v = x0 + float(np.median(pts[:, 1])), y0 + float(np.median(pts[:, 0]))
    coffee_top = world_point(obs, RIGHT, u, v)
    print("sugar top world", np.round(sugar_top, 4))
    print("coffee surface world", np.round(coffee_top, 4))
    return sugar_top, coffee_top


def main():
    r = Robot()
    print("connected", r.base, "budget", r.spec().get("budget"))
    # The live service is already at the frozen initial demonstration state. This call is free.
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
    sugar_top, coffee_top = perceive_sugar_and_coffee(obs)

    # Sugar cube center lies slightly below the observed top face. First align above it.
    sugar_center = sugar_top.copy(); sugar_center[2] -= 0.028
    # Travel across the counter at a lifted height to clear the coffee maker and
    # cabinet fronts; descend only after the gripper is above the saucer.
    pregrasp = sugar_center.copy(); pregrasp[2] = max(1.34, sugar_center[2] + 0.13)
    pose_servo(r, pregrasp, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=-1.0, label="sugar pregrasp")

    # Descend, close around the cube, and lift it clear of the saucer.
    pose_servo(r, sugar_center, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=-1.0, label="sugar grasp descent")
    r.submit("joint_position", action_rows(np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][4:11]), 1.0, 20),
             cameras=[LEFT, EYE], video="none", interpolate="hold", note="close gripper on sugar cube")
    lift = sugar_center.copy(); lift[2] += 0.40
    pose_servo(r, lift, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=1.0, label="lift sugar")

    # Carry above the appliance tops, then descend over the mug.
    above_coffee = coffee_top.copy(); above_coffee[2] += 0.34
    pose_servo(r, above_coffee, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=1.0, label="transport sugar above coffee")

    # Release just above the mug rim.
    drop = coffee_top.copy(); drop[2] += 0.055
    pose_servo(r, drop, target_R=R_GRASP, grip=1.0, label="place sugar over coffee")
    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"])
    r.submit("joint_position", action_rows(now[4:11], -1.0, 25), cameras=[LEFT, RIGHT, EYE], video="none",
             interpolate="hold", note="release sugar into coffee")

    # Retract to the original high pose so the gripper clears the sugar and milk.
    home_q = np.array([0.0025, -1.0214, -0.0184, -2.2941, 0.0493, 1.5042, 0.6876])
    send_arm(r, home_q, grip=-1.0, seconds=3.0, cameras=CAMERAS, note="park arm clear of objects")
    final = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
    final.save("/app/runs/final")
    print("finished sugar placement; final time left", final.meta.get("time_left_s"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
